title: Give execution_policies a stable semantic snapshot identity

phases.objective: Make execution_policies expose one stable natural UNIQUE ordering key for canonical semantic snapshots while keeping this pull request schema-only and mutation-free against live Staging and Production.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A clean exact commit builds the disposable Staging schema bundle from schema.sql and the full ordered migration chain.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: execution_policies resolves uq_execution_policies_policy_identity over policy_group and policy_key as its stable semantic snapshot ordering key; historical duplicate identities fail the disposable migration replay rather than being silently normalized.
steps: The canonical baseline replaces idx_policy_group_key with uq_execution_policies_policy_identity.
The new idempotent migration drops the legacy non-unique index when present and adds the UNIQUE identity only when absent.
The focused regression locks the baseline and migration contract.
The disposable bundle build replays the complete migration chain on a clean commit and generates canonical semantic outputs.
No live Staging database, Production database, provider, or Hostinger mutation is authorized by this pull request.
assertions: schema.sql exposes exactly the intended UNIQUE natural identity for execution_policies.
The legacy idx_policy_group_key baseline index is removed.
The migration is replay-safe when the baseline already contains the UNIQUE identity.
A disposable schema bundle build must no longer fail with semantic snapshot table has no stable unique ordering key: execution_policies.
The reviewed Production recovery baseline checksum is updated to the exact new schema.sql bytes without authorizing any Production Apply.
